Introduction

Choi Jiung, is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, dancer, and composer under FNC Entertainment. He is best known as a member of the boy group P1Harmony.

On September 16, Jiung was revealed as the fourth member of P1Harmony. The group officially debuted on October 28, 2020, with their first mini-album "Disharmony : Stand Out".
